from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, json

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/worktrees/rollout-zombie-fix")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")

def run(args,check=True):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,env=env)
    print("$"," ".join(args))
    print(p.stdout)
    print(p.stderr)
    if check and p.returncode!=0:
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    return p

probe=run(["python3","-c","import do_again.service.rollout as r; print(r.__file__)"])
if str(wt/"src/do_again/service/rollout.py") not in probe.stdout.strip():
    raise SystemExit("worktree module still not selected")

run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/service/rollout.py","tests/test_rollout.py"])
run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_rollout"])
run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests"])
run(["git","diff","--check"])

status=run(["git","status","--short"]).stdout
print(status)
if not status.strip():
    raise SystemExit("expected rollout/test changes missing")

run(["git","add","src/do_again/service/rollout.py","tests/test_rollout.py"])
run(["git","commit","-m","Ignore zombie daemon children during rollout preflight"])
run(["git","push","-u","origin","fix/rollout-ignore-zombie-children"])

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps({"branch":"fix/rollout-ignore-zombie-children","head":head},indent=2))
print("ROLLOUT_ZOMBIE_CHILD_FIX_WORKTREE_TESTS_OK")
